description: Create comprehensive Prisma schema with 88+ models covering all 18 CIOS modules. Includes 7-level org hierarchy, full GHG accounting (Scope 1/2/3 with all 15 Scope 3 categories), Rules Engine, Data Lineage, Explainable AI, Carbon Finance, ESG Disclosure, Digital MRV, Verification, Security, and AI Agent subsystems.
steps: Create prisma/schema.prisma with PostgreSQL datasource and Prisma client generator with pgvector preview feature
Define Organization hierarchy models: Organization, BusinessUnit, Facility, Building, ProductionLine, Equipment, EmissionSource - with full parent-child relationships and 7-level hierarchy
Define Master Data models: Product, RawMaterial, Fuel, FuelType, Vehicle, Refrigerant, Supplier, LogisticsRoute, EnergySource, WasteType, WaterSource
Define Activity Data models: ActivityData, ActivityDataEntry, DataImportJob, DataImportMapping, DataValidationRule, DataQualityScore, IoTDevice, IoTReading, MeterReading

Define Emission Engine models: EmissionCalculation, EmissionResult, EmissionAllocation, CalculationMethodology, CalculationFormula, UncertaintyAnalysis, Scope3Category (all 15 categories), EmissionInventory
Define Emission Factor Library models: EmissionFactor, EmissionFactorSource, EmissionFactorVersion, EmissionFactorCategory, UnitConversion, EmissionFactorUpdate
Define AI Engine models: AIAnalysis, AIRecommendation, AIPrediction, AIModel, AITrainingData, AnomalyDetection, DataGapAnalysis, AIConfidenceScore
Define AI Roadmap models: DecarbonizationRoadmap, RoadmapMilestone, RoadmapAction, AbatementTechnology, MACCCurve, InvestmentAnalysis (CAPEX, OPEX, ROI, IRR, NPV, Payback)
Define AI Scenario Simulator models: Scenario, ScenarioAssumption, ScenarioResult, ScenarioComparison, CarbonBudget, TargetPathway
Define Digital MRV models: MRVPlan, Measurement, Report, ReportTemplate, ReportSection, ReportDataPoint, MonitoringPlan, MonitoringParameter
Define Verification Center models: VerificationEngagement, VerificationScope, AuditTrail, AuditEvidence, VerificationFinding, VerificationStatement, DigitalSignature, EvidencePackage, VersionHistory
Define Carbon Finance models: CarbonCredit, CarbonOffset, CarbonPrice, InternalCarbonPrice, ETSPosition, RECertificate, PPA, VoluntaryMarket, CarbonTrade
Define ESG Disclosure models: DisclosureFramework, DisclosureRequirement, DisclosureResponse, DisclosureReport, CDPResponse, ISSBReport, CSRDReport, TCFDReport, ReportGeneration
Define Rules Engine models: Rule, RuleSet, RuleCondition, RuleAction, RuleExecution, RuleVersion, CountryRegulation, IndustryStandard
Define Data Lineage models: DataLineageNode, DataLineageEdge, DataTransformation, DataSource, DataVersion, LineageGraph
Define Explainable AI models: AIExplanation, ExplanationStep, AssumptionLog, CalculationTrace, ConfidenceBreakdown, EvidenceLink
Define Security & Auth models: User, Role, Permission, RolePermission, UserRole, Team, AuditLog, Session, APIKey, AccessPolicy, EncryptionKey
Define AI Agent models: Agent, AgentTask, AgentExecution, AgentTool, MCPServer, MCPConnection, AgentConversation, AgentMessage
Define SBTi & Target models: ScienceBasedTarget, TargetType, TargetProgress, NetZeroCommitment, FLAGTarget, BaselineYear
Define Notification & Workflow models: Notification, NotificationPreference, Workflow, WorkflowStep, WorkflowExecution, Approval
Add proper indexes, unique constraints, and relations across all models
Verify: npx prisma validate passes successfully
Verify: npx prisma format to ensure schema is properly formatted
acceptance_criteria: 7-level organizational hierarchy is defined with proper relations
Rules Engine, Data Lineage, and Explainable AI models are included
npx prisma validate passes without errors
findings: Schema created with 148 models (well above 88+ minimum) and 3452 lines (above 2000+ minimum). 25 enums for type safety. All 15 Scope 3 categories represented. Created .env file (gitignored) with placeholder values for prisma validate to work. Prisma 6 with postgresqlExtensions preview feature and vector extension configured. npx prisma validate and npx prisma format both pass. Build and lint pass cleanly.
